prompt: Single continuous shot. Three raw ingredients lined up on the counter in hard spotlight: a chicken breast, a head of broccoli, a container of day-old rice — one second of stillness. Then the line explodes into motion: chicken diced fast, hitting a screaming wok with garlic, broccoli tossed in high, catching flame light. Money shot: the cold rice crumbled in and tossed in a fire-lit arc, grains separating and toasting, soy sauce hitting the wok edge with a violent hiss and backlit steam flare. Final beat: the loaded bowl, chopsticks lifting. Warm dramatic light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: one beat of silence, then the wok roar. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption: Três coisas que toda geladeira brasileira tem — e um jantar que ninguém esperava delas. Arroz de ontem vira arroz frito de verdade: solto, dourado, com frango puxado no alho e brócolis crocante. **Sábado que vem: [A] ovo, banana madura e aveia ou [B] salsicha, batata e requeijão? Comenta A ou B 👇**
